# Function
All necessary functions
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
## Get GSEA plot (bar plot, p value)
get_fgsea_plot <- function(df,Organ,ylim){
  Organ <- Organ
  df <- df
  ylim <- ylim
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Regulation = ifelse(NES > 0, "Up", "Down")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log_padj_mutated = ifelse(NES > 0, -log10(padj), log10(padj)))
  df_up <- df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    slice(1:5)
  df_down <- df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
    slice(1:5)
  df_subset <- rbind(df_up,df_down)
  
  p.fgsea <- ggplot(df_subset,aes(x=reorder(pathway,log_padj_mutated),y=log_padj_mutated,fill=factor(Regulation))) + 
    geom_bar(stat='identity') + theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
                                      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                      plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
                                      axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                      axis.text= element_text(size = 5)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = log10(0.05)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue","red")) +
    ylim(-ylim,ylim)+
    coord_flip() + labs(y='-log10(padj)',x='pathways')
  return(p.fgsea)
}

## save plot as PDF files
save_pdf <- function(x,type,Organ,age,condition) {
  filename <- paste(paste(type,Organ,age,condition,sep="_"),".pdf",sep="")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir,filename),plot=x)
}

## save pheatmap
save_pheatmap_pdf <- function(x, filename, width=7, height=7) {
    stopifnot(!missing(x))
    stopifnot(!missing(filename))
    pdf(filename, width=width, height=height)
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(x$gtable)
    dev.off()
}
```

# Read data
#Generate meta file dynamically and read data according to this meta file
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
sample <- data.frame()
dir <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/05_figure4_Histone_CutandRun/data"
data.list <- list()

for (imarker in c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3")) {
  for (ihour in c("00hr","48hr")){
    
  filename <- paste(ihour,"_",imarker,"_WT_KO_merge_annotated_tag_for_R",".txt",sep="")
  file <- read.delim(file.path(dir,filename),sep="\t",skip=1,quote = "")
  colnames(file) <- c("Row.names","Chr","Start","End","Gene Name","Annotation","Distance_to_nearest_RefSeq_TSS","WT_1","WT_2","JunBKO_1","JunBKO_2")
  data.list[[imarker]][[ihour]] <- file
  }
}

```

# Meta data
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}

database <- data.frame(marker=rep(c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3"),each=4,times=2),
                       hour=rep(c("00hr","48hr"),each=16),
                       condition=rep(c("WT","JunBKO"),each=2,times=8),
                       replicate=(rep(c("1","2"),times=16))
                       )
database$rowname <-paste(database$marker,database$hour,database$condition,database$replicate,sep="_")


```

# Generate count matrix
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
matrix.list <- list()

for (imarker in c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3")) {
  for (ihour in c("00hr","48hr")){
 
  file <- data.list[[imarker]][[ihour]]
  countData <- as.matrix(file[8:11])
  rownames(countData) <- file$Row.names
  mode(countData) <- "integer"
  matrix.list[[imarker]][[ihour]] <- countData
  }
}
```

#annotation
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
final.list <- list()
for (imarker in c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3")) {
  for (ihour in c("00hr","48hr")){
     resdata <-  res.list[[imarker]][[ihour]]
     file <- data.list[[imarker]][[ihour]]
onlyname <-subset(file,select=c("Row.names","Chr","Start","End","Gene Name","Annotation","Distance_to_nearest_RefSeq_TSS"))
finaltable <- merge(resdata,onlyname,by="Row.names",sort=FALSE)

#scatter plot tag data only by log2FC
finaltable$WT_mean <- rowMeans(finaltable[,c(8,9)], na.rm=TRUE)
finaltable$KO_mean <- rowMeans(finaltable[,c(10,11)], na.rm=TRUE)
finaltable$WT_mean_log2 <- log(finaltable[,c('WT_mean')], 2)
finaltable$KO_mean_log2 <- log(finaltable[,c('KO_mean')], 2)
final.list[[imarker]][[ihour]] <- finaltable
  
# savedir_table <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/exp163-cutandrun_renanalysis/03_table/no_filtered"
# write.table(finaltable,file.path(savedir_table,paste("Cut_and_Runseq_",imarker,"_",ihour,"_KO_WT",".txt",sep="")), quote= F, sep = "\t",row.names = F)

}
}
```


#FDR<0.05,log2FC0.585 (1.5fold),baseMean >10
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
#add color by using tag only data

log2FC <- 0.585
FDR <- 0.05
baseMean_value <- 10

for (imarker in c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3")) {
  for (ihour in c("00hr","48hr")){
  finaltable <- final.list[[imarker]] [[ihour]]
finaltable$color <- ifelse(finaltable$padj < FDR & abs(finaltable$log2FoldChange) >= log2FC & finaltable$baseMean >baseMean_value,ifelse(finaltable$log2FoldChange > log2FC & finaltable$baseMean >baseMean_value ,'red','blue'),'gray')

#count the log2FC
library(dplyr)
df_ko <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & log2FoldChange > log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_ko_gene <- as.matrix(df_ko$`Gene Name`)
df_wt <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & log2FoldChange < -log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_wt_gene <- as.matrix(df_wt$`Gene Name`)

df <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & abs(log2FoldChange) > log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_gene <- as.matrix(df$`Gene Name`)

paste("ko=",nrow(df_ko))
paste("wt=",nrow(df_wt))

nodifference <-nrow(finaltable)- nrow(df_ko)-nrow(df_wt)
totalACRs<-nrow(finaltable)
paste(nodifference)
```

# scatter plot: plot total ACRs using gray color
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
library(ggplot2)
color<- c(red = "red", gray = "gray", blue ="blue")

for (imarker in c("H3K4me1","H3K4me3","H3K27ac","H3K27me3")) {
  for (ihour in c("00hr","48hr")){
  finaltable <- final.list[[imarker]][[ihour]]

finaltable$color <- ifelse(finaltable$padj < FDR & abs(finaltable$log2FoldChange) >= log2FC & finaltable$baseMean >baseMean_value,ifelse(finaltable$log2FoldChange > log2FC & finaltable$baseMean >baseMean_value ,'red','blue'),'gray')

#count the log2FC

library(dplyr)
df_ko <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & log2FoldChange > log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_ko_gene <- as.matrix(df_ko$`Gene Name`)
df_wt <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & log2FoldChange < -log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_wt_gene <- as.matrix(df_wt$`Gene Name`)

df <- dplyr::filter(finaltable, padj < FDR & abs(log2FoldChange) > log2FC & baseMean >baseMean_value)
df_gene <- as.matrix(df$`Gene Name`)

paste("ko=",nrow(df_ko))
paste("wt=",nrow(df_wt))

totalACRs<-nrow(finaltable)-nrow(df_wt)-nrow(df_ko)


p <- ggplot(finaltable, aes(WT_mean_log2, KO_mean_log2, col= color)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color) +
  labs(x="WT tags (log2)",y="JunB-KO tags (log2)")+
  ggtitle(imarker) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  annotate("text", x=Inf,y=Inf, hjust=1,vjust=1,label = totalACRs ,size= 8,col= "gray" )+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 12), breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 4))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 12), breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 4))+
  annotate("text", x=Inf,y=-Inf, hjust=1,vjust=0,label =nrow(df_wt),size= 8,col= "blue" )+
  annotate("text", x=-Inf,y=Inf, hjust=0,vjust=1,label =nrow(df_ko),size= 8,col= "red")
p


savedir_png <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/05_figure4_Histone_CutandRun/plot"

ggsave(file.path(savedir_png,paste("Cut_and_Runseq_",imarker,"_",ihour,"_KO_WT","_baseMean",baseMean_value,"_FDR",FDR,"_abslog2FC_",log2FC,"_totalACRs.png",sep="")), width = 4, height = 4)

}
}
```
